evidence.quote:
## Ein führendes historisches Zweckmodell

**A_PRACTITIONER_THERAPEUTIC_IATROMATHEMATICAL_COMPENDIUM** — Composite working reference for a medical household, institutional infirmary, or practitioner network: simples and preparations; locally distinct baths/applications; celestial/calendar consultation for timing or prognosis.

Mechanismus: Separate Herbal, balneological, and celestial source fascicles or exemplar batches, then workshop assembly; no required cross-page key. On the target pages, image geometry is the working prior owner and text is fitted locally; this remains a target inference, not a universal medieval rule. Plausibly section-specialized copying or sequential additions within a workshop/institution; not evidence for several authors or professions.

Der praktische Zusammenhang ist kein seitenübergreifender Code: bebilderte
Pflanzen-/Zubereitungsartikel, lokal getrennte Bade-/Anwendungsstationen und
selbständige Himmels-/Kalenderinstrumente können in derselben
Praktikerbibliothek konsultiert werden. Die V76-Wertung 236 ist nur ein
knapper Arbeitslead.

## Genau ein echter Rivale

**B_NATURAL_ARTIFICIAL_CELESTIAL_IMAGE_ATLAS_MODELBOOK** — Learned image atlas/modelbook of natural things, bathing/artificial works, and celestial diagrams for copying, teaching, classification, or consultation rather than a patient workflow.

Mechanismus: Independent image batches gathered by a workshop or patron, locally annotated, and assembled as a broad visual dossier. Image exemplars are copied first and explanatory/local text is fitted into available space. Distinct exemplar batches and later workshop reuse naturally admit multiple hands and stages.

Der Rivale erreicht 235 Punkte und erklärt Bilddominanz, lokale
Beschriftung, mehrere Hände und fehlende Crosspointer besonders sparsam.
Er verliert nur knapp, weil das Material→Anwendung→Zeit/Bedingung-Modell
einen kohärenteren praktischen Grund für die gemeinsame Aufbewahrung bietet.
Die Auswahl bleibt `NEAR_TIE__WORKING_LEAD_NOT_IDENTIFICATION`.

decision.reason: The same V80 report explicitly presents model A as the leading historical purpose and model B as its one genuine rival. Both complete cards include image-led local fitting, independent source batches and workshop assembly. Those shared production mechanisms do not erase the competing purpose claim: therapeutic practitioner consultation across materials/applications/timing versus a learned copying/teaching/classification image atlas rather than a patient workflow. This supports the historical alternative_to relation over both complete models, as already recommended in identity_batch_c links[0]. It does not prove logical incompatibility in every historical book or identify the manuscript purpose.
decision.scope_limit: Only these V80 full-purpose models. Near-tie 236/235 is source-authored ranking, not a Bayes factor, independent observation or winning meaning. Shared image/assembly clauses are not separate duplicate hypotheses; no status or failure transfers.
decision.reviewer: root and independent ED primary-source peer
